paragraphs: R' Hananiah bar Yitzhak. See the entry R' Hinena bar Yitzhak.[^1]

notes.text: The heading has חנניה, Hananiah, and the target חיננא, Hinena. The different forms are preserved, with conventional English vowels. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
